hook: A new mass spectrometry method separates fatty acid double-bond position and geometry in bacteria.
summary: A chemical derivatization that preserves stereochemistry, paired with ion mobility mass spectrometry, resolves both where double bonds sit and whether they are cis or trans. It revealed dose-dependent antibiotic adaptation in Pseudomonas aeruginosa and mapped lipid isomers in mixed colonies. The biological interpretations are suggestive and come from a few bacterial species in culture.
title: Anti -Dihydroxylation-Enabled Dual-Resolution Profiling and Imaging of Fatty Acid C═C Bond Isomers
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
